properties._note: ownerRef deliberately carries NO `$ref`, and that is a known, MEASURED exception to ADR-062 rule 7 — not an oversight. gate-54 reports it as a relation-shaped property missing its canonical $ref, and adding `"$ref": "player"` here is the remediation the gate prescribes. Doing so BREAKS the character create dialog: `character.ocName` already declares `$ref: "player"`, and with a second player-targeted relation on the same schema the dialog no longer renders a player selector at all. Reproduced twice on PR #289 — tests/e2e/spec-coverage/detail-forms-admin.spec.ts:570 `character create dialog exposes a player (ocName) selector` failed with `expect(locator).toBeVisible()` on `input[placeholder*="player" i]`, 1 failed / 170 passed, on two independent runs, and passes on development. Re-attempt only with that e2e green. See ConductionNL/.github#231.
